plugins.description: Connect Claude to your mailboxes over a remote MCP server operated by CCMS. Read, search, organize, and send mail across IMAP/SMTP and Outlook/Office 365 accounts. Credentials are stored encrypted on the MAILsimple server. Free for one mailbox; Pro is $9/month or $90/year for unlimited mailboxes.
